2023-10-09
First notice of the parking lot collision came in from the insured, who describes a low-speed impact while backing out
of a space. The driver is named on the policy, and the insured has agreed to make the vehicle available for
inspection.
2023-10-21
Photos from the insured show rear-end damage that fits the described impact, though they do not settle every detail.
No independent witnesses to the collision have come forward.
2023-11-19
The police report lists the claimant as an occupant of the other vehicle, which matches the account given so far. The
claimant is now represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
2023-12-24
The claimant's attorney submitted a demand alleging a concussion from the impact. The reported injury is plausible
for a collision of this kind.
2024-01-08
The medical records show treatment that ran somewhat longer than is usual for this injury. I have requested the full
treatment notes and therapy logs to understand the timeline.
2024-01-17
No earlier injury to the same body area appears in the records received so far. I will confirm this once the prior
provider list is complete.
2024-02-16
The claimant has told the same acocunt in every conversation with me and with counsel present. The details have not
shifted between contacts.
2024-02-23
No earlier damage to the claimant's vehicle is known, and the repair estimate matches the impact that was described.
Nothing in the file suggests the damage happened before the coverage started.
2024-03-17
Policy review confirms that coverage was active at the time of loss and that the driver is named on the policy. The file
stays open pending the treatment records and the final repair invoice.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
